method.name: Deserialize
method.summary: Deserialize an instance from a byte array using DataContractSerializer.
method.param: Byte array containing the serialized data.
method.returns: Deserialized instance of the requested type, or null for null or empty input.

method.name: FromFile
method.summary: Read and deserialize an instance from a file using DataContractSerializer.
method.param: Path to the file to read.
method.returns: Instance of TResult if the file exists and deserialization succeeds; otherwise null if the path is null, empty, whitespace, or the file is absent.

method.name: ParseBase64
method.summary: Deserialize an instance from a Base64-encoded binary XML string.
method.returns: Instance of TResult if parsing succeeds; otherwise null for null, empty, or whitespace input.

method.name: ParseBase64Type
method.summary: Deserialize an instance from a Base64-encoded binary XML string using a runtime Type value.
method.returns: Instance of the requested runtime type if parsing succeeds; otherwise null for null, empty, or whitespace input or a null runtime type.

method.name: Serialize
method.summary: Serialize an instance to a binary buffer using DataContractSerializer.
method.returns: Binary buffer representing the serialized instance.

method.name: ToBase64String
method.summary: Serialize an instance to a Base64-encoded binary XML string using DataContractSerializer.
method.returns: Base64-encoded binary XML representation of the instance.
method.remarks: The concrete runtime type of instance is used when constructing the underlying DataContractSerializer.

method.name: ToFile
method.summary: Serialize and atomically create the specified file using DataContractSerializer without overwriting an existing destination.
method.returns: True if the file was created successfully; false if the path is null, empty, or whitespace, or the destination already exists.

method.name: TryParseBase64
method.summary: Attempt to deserialize an instance from a Base64-encoded binary XML string.
method.param: Deserialized instance if the operation succeeds; otherwise null.
method.returns: True if parsing succeeded; otherwise false for null, empty, or whitespace input or a null result. Invalid serialized data throws.

method.name: TryParseBase64Type
method.summary: Attempt to deserialize an instance from a Base64-encoded binary XML string using a runtime Type value.
method.param: Deserialized instance if the operation succeeds; otherwise null.
method.returns: True if parsing succeeded; otherwise false for null, empty, or whitespace input, a null runtime type, or a null result. Invalid serialized data throws.
